ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.title: Relic Coupons
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.descript: Earn Relic Coupons from Elites and Chests. Coupons pair with Archipelago Relic items, granting relics through natural rewards or the Archipelago Rewards menu. A negative counter means you need to defeat more Elites or find more eligible relic rewards; a positive counter means you need to receive more AP Relic items.
ARCHIPELAGO_RELIC_RELIC_COUPONS.flavor: A promise that somewhere in the multiworld, a relic is waiting for you.
